info.title: air-model-gateway
info.description:
The AIR platform's model gateway, across Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini and a
self-hosted slot: `POST /v1/generate` for text (optionally structured JSON) and
`POST /v1/embed` for vectors. Choose a model class (`local`, `auto`, `cloud`) or a
published embedding model; the gateway picks the models and handles failover, retries,
cost accounting and caching.

**Streaming.** `stream: true` on `/v1/generate` answers with Server-Sent Events:
`start`, `delta`s, then `done` or `error`. The gateway fails over between models only
before the first token; errors before then are ordinary HTTP errors. If `done` has
`refusal: true`, discard the deltas (the non-streamed answer's `content` is empty).

**Authentication.** Every `/v1` call except health and readiness carries the calling
service's token in `X-API-Key`, checked before the body is read (no key is 401 whatever
the body). Each service is granted specific operations (`generate`, `embed`); anything
else is 403.

**Stateless.** The gateway keeps no conversation: send the whole history on every
`/v1/generate` call. Unknown fields are 422.

**Errors.** Every error body is `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with a stable
`code` and the `request_id`, an unknown path (`not_found`) or method
(`method_not_allowed`) included. Retry only 429 `rate_limited`, 502 and 503, with
backoff; never 429 `budget_exceeded` or any 4xx.

**Tracing.** Send `X-Request-ID` (up to 128 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`) to have it
logged with the call and echoed back; without one, or with any other value, the
gateway generates it.

The consumer guide is docs/04-integration.md in the air-model-gateway repo.

post.summary: Generate text (optionally structured JSON, optionally streamed) from a model class
post.description:
Messages in, one answer out: chat, classification, summaries, extraction.
With `stream: true`, the answer arrives as Server-Sent Events.

200.description: Without `stream`: the answer as JSON (GenerateOutput). With `stream: true`: Server-Sent Events, each `event: <name>` plus one `data:` line of JSON: one `start` (StreamStart), then `delta` events (StreamDelta) whose `content` concatenates to the answer, then `done` (GenerateSummary) or, if the stream fails after it started, `error` (Problem).

403.description: `code: policy_denied`: the calling service has no grant for this operation, or chose a model class, embedding model or preferred provider outside its grant, or sent `pin` without a pin grant (needed outside local). Don't retry.

422.description: `code: validation_error`: the body failed validation (including the size limits); `detail` lists each `field: message`. `code: invalid_model_choice`: a choice that means nothing here (an unpublished embedding model, a provider the class doesn't offer, a malformed pin, a pin to a model with no price or one its provider doesn't have). `code: provider_rejected`: every provider refused the request as invalid (too long for the model, a parameter it won't take); `detail` has their reasons. Don't retry any of these unchanged.

429.description: `code: rate_limited`: the service's own rate limit, or every rung of the chain was throttled (by a provider or the gateway's provider quota). Retry with backoff. `code: budget_exceeded`: the service's daily budget is spent; don't retry before `Retry-After` (the next UTC day).

502.description: Every rung of the model's chain failed for a reason other than the request (`code: provider_unavailable`); `detail` names each. Retry with backoff.

get.description:
Liveness: the process is up, and which build it runs. Never consults a
provider.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional. Correlates this call across services and logs. A value that doesn't match the pattern is replaced with a generated id.

get.description:
Readiness: should this replica receive traffic?

Gated on whether at least one provider is reachable: "no provider answers"
is the one condition under which this replica genuinely cannot serve.

Redis is reported but never gates. Without it the cache misses and rate
limits fall back to per replica, so the replica still serves correctly,
and pulling every replica out of rotation over a Redis blip would turn a
degraded cache into a full outage.

Action.title: Action
Action.description:
Policy actions. GENERATE and EMBED are named after the routes they guard
(POST /v1/generate, POST /v1/embed), so a grant reads the same as the call
it allows: one vocabulary across routes, policy files, metrics and the
audit line.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: The build's git revision, as in `/v1/health`.

preferred_providers.title: Preferred Providers
preferred_providers.description: Providers you may name in `provider`; null means any the class offers.

may_pin.title: May Pin
may_pin.description: Whether you may send `pin` (an exact provider:model).

Capabilities.title: Capabilities
Capabilities.description:
What the calling service can ask for: the discovery endpoint for model
choices. Chains reflect the owner's configuration, including any
per-service tuning, and may change; the class and embedding names don't.

model.title: Model
model.description: A published embedding model, `<local|cloud>-<dimensions>-v<version>`, e.g. `local-768-v1`. Required: it is your index's identity. A name never changes meaning, so vectors from it always stay comparable; `/v1/capabilities` lists the published names.

input.title: Input
input.description: The texts to embed, at most 2,048 of at most 32,000 characters each; one vector comes back per text.

allowed.title: Allowed
allowed.description: Whether your service may use this embedding model.

available.title: Available
available.description: Whether this deployment can serve it: its one provider is configured (`providers`). An embedding model never fails over, so false means every call would fail.

embedding_model.title: Embedding Model
embedding_model.description: The published name the vectors belong to.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Length of every vector; check it against your index.

model.title: Model
model.description: The provider's model behind that name.

embeddings.title: Embeddings
embeddings.description: One vector per input text, in order.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Priced from the gateway's table; 0 for local models.

allowed.title: Allowed
allowed.description: Whether your service may use this class.

available.title: Available
available.description: Whether this deployment can serve it: some provider in the chain is configured (`providers`). False means every call would fail, whatever `allowed` says.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: The models behind it for your service, in the order tried (provider:model).

model.description: Where the model runs, not which model: `local` (our own servers; the prompt never leaves the network), `cloud` (cloud providers), or `auto` (the gateway's choice, which may be either). The gateway owner decides which models serve each class; `/v1/capabilities` shows them for your service.

provider.description: Optional preference within the class: that provider's models are tried first, the rest stay as fallback. Must be one the class offers (422 otherwise), and one your service may prefer (403 otherwise).

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: Operator tools only: an exact `provider:model` (e.g. `anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5`), bypassing the classes, with no fallback. Needs a `pin` grant outside local. When set, `model` and `provider` must be unset.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The whole conversation, oldest first. The gateway keeps no history: the caller sends every turn it wants the model to see, on every call. At most 500 messages and 800,000 characters of content in all.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Output token cap, at least 1. Thinking models (Gemini) spend part of it before the visible answer; leave room (300+ for structured output).

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: 0-2. Provider default when omitted. Ignored by Anthropic, whose API version `2026-10-21` rejects sampling parameters.

json_schema.title: Json Schema
json_schema.description: A JSON Schema the answer must follow; `content` is then a JSON string. Validate it on your side: the gateway forwards the schema, it doesn't check the answer.

schema_name.title: Schema Name
schema_name.description: A name for `json_schema` (some providers require one).

cache_prefix.title: Cache Prefix
cache_prefix.description: Ask the provider to cache the stable prompt prefix, if supported: the system prompt and, in a conversation (once there is an assistant turn), the history, so each new turn re-reads earlier ones at the cache rate.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Stream the answer as Server-Sent Events (`text/event-stream`): `start`, then `delta` events with text as it is generated, then `done` (GenerateSummary) or `error` (Problem). Errors before the first token are ordinary HTTP errors.

cache.title: Cache
cache.description: Use the gateway's response cache: an identical request from this service within the cache TTL gets the stored answer at no cost. `false` always asks the provider (e.g. for a fresh sample of a creative answer).

messages.content: Classify sentiment: I love this product!

id.title: Id
id.description: Gateway-assigned id; a cache hit returns the original call's id.

model_class.description: The class that served the call; null when it was pinned.

model.title: Model
model.description: The concrete model that answered, after resolving the class and failover.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Priced from the gateway's table; 0 for local models and cache hits.

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: Served from the gateway's response cache.

refusal.title: Refusal
refusal.description: The provider's safety layer declined; never cached.

finish_reason.title: Finish Reason
finish_reason.description: Normalized across providers: `stop` (finished), `length` (cut off at `max_tokens`: treat structured output as invalid; never cached), `refusal`, or `other`.

provider_finish_reason.title: Provider Finish Reason
provider_finish_reason.description: The provider's own finish reason, unmapped (for diagnostics only).

content.title: Content
content.description: The answer (a JSON string when `json_schema` was sent).

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: The build's git revision (`-dirty`: built from uncommitted changes; `unknown`: not recorded). Record it with any test result.

ModelClass.description:
What a caller of POST /v1/generate chooses instead of a model: where the
model runs. The owner decides, in deploy/routing.yaml, which models serve
each class (per service, if needed).
ModelClass.title: ModelClass

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Provider name -> answered its health check, and its key isn't being refused (false after repeated auth failures on real calls).

redis.title: Redis
redis.description: Present only when Redis is configured. Reported, never gates readiness.

Usage.description:
Token counts as the provider reports them. For embeddings, total_tokens
equals prompt_tokens (there is no completion).
